facts.fact: The Global Fund's Office of the Inspector General, auditing Togo's health supply-chain digitalisation, states there is an 'absence of coordinated national digitalization strategy' amid multiple digitalisation initiatives; the document gives no audit date other than its publication date, 2025-06-04, which is used here.

note: Audit report; one passage states the absence of a coordinated national digitalization strategy, recorded as standing none. The passage does not name Togo Digital 2025.
